title: Mojang End Crsytals
description: Changes the symbols on the End Crystal to spell out "Mojang" in English.
body:
This tiny resource pack changes the symbols on End Crystals to spell out "Mojang" in English. The bedrock base of the crystal was also updated to match Jappa's bedrock texture, instead of the Programmer Art bedrock.

The last addition of this resource pack makes a small tweak to the item sprite to change the tiny symbol to "M"
